panel.name: tab_action_mappings
panel.label: Actions
panel.tool_tip: Action Mappings: what each stick and button of the gamepad does, for each mode.

plus_ps_combo.name: action_mode
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: Select a mode to edit its mappings.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: restore_actions_defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Restore Defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Restores the default action mappings for the current mode.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: action_mode_enabled
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Mode enabled
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Uncheck to lock this mode's mappings and stop converting game-control input to this mode's actions.

plus_ps_slider_compat.name: speed_factor
plus_ps_slider_compat.tool_tip: FlyCam: camera move speed. Mouselook: turn/look speed. Avatar: turn speed. Only shown while editing FlyCam, Mouselook, or Avatar mappings.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: flycam_allow_roll
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Allow roll
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Allow Roll input to rotate the flycam about its forward axis. Only shown while editing FlyCam mappings.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: flycam_hide_cursor
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Hide mouse cursor
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Hide the mouse cursor while flying the flycam. It reappears when the mouse is moved and hides again 5 seconds later, or within 1 second once the flycam moves. Only shown while editing FlyCam mappings.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: flycam_crosshair
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Show crosshair
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Draw a crosshair at the center of the screen while flying the flycam. Only shown while editing FlyCam mappings.

panel.name: tab_device_mappings
panel.label: Devices
panel.tool_tip: Device Mappings: what each axis and button of the selected device is to the viewer.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: restore_device_defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Restore Defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Restores default settings for the selected device.

panel.name: tab_device_options
panel.label: Calibration
panel.tool_tip: Device Options: the live input of the selected device, and its offset, invert and dead zone for each axis.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: restore_device_options_defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Restore Defaults
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Restores the default Offset, Invert, and Dead Zone for every axis of the selected device.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: auto_calibrate
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Auto calibrate
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Samples the selected device's raw axes over 5 frames; any axis that doesn't move is assumed to be at rest, and its Offset and Dead Zone are set from that reading.

panel.name: tab_server_data
panel.label: Server Data
panel.tool_tip: Server Data: what is sent to the region with the gamepad's input, as it is sent.
panel.plus_ps_text: Data sent to the server: canonical axes/buttons, then the semantic axes/buttons for the current mode.
